pages.text: An owned horse is your horse. Anyone else who tries to climb on as the primary rider gets $(thing)bucked off$() immediately.$(br2)The horse will still tolerate a second rider — provided you, the owner, are already in the saddle. Co-op trips work; mount theft does not.

pages.title: Toggle It Off
pages.text: Multiplayer servers can opt out by editing the mod's $(thing)config file$(), $(item)betterhorses-common.json$(). Set $(thing)horseExclusivityEnabled$() to $(item)false$() and any player can mount any owned horse — handy for ranches and shared stables.$(br2)The same config also exposes toggles for stabilizers, medkits, hitchposts, hooves, and multi-riding.
